arguments.value: Cremer Oleo GmbH & Co KG and Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical Inc entered into a supply agreement under which Cremer Oleo GmbH & Co KG will supply triheptanoin in bulk, and Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical Inc will buy it exclusively from Cremer Oleo GmbH & Co KG for a defined field of use. The product must meet the agreed specifications and GMP standards, and Cremer Oleo GmbH & Co KG must provide supporting quality documents. Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical Inc places orders by purchase order, pays in euros after invoicing, and handles final release of the product. Delivery is generally EXW, title passes only after full payment, and pricing is set each contract year with limits on increases; if no new price is agreed, Cremer Oleo GmbH & Co KG may stop deliveries. If the product does not conform, Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical Inc may reject it and Cremer Oleo GmbH & Co KG must replace it or refund the purchase price. Cremer Oleo GmbH & Co KG does not guarantee the product’s pharmaceutical effectiveness, safety, or suitability for Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical Inc’s intended use, and liability is largely limited to intentional misconduct or gross negligence. Each party must indemnify the other for certain third-party claims caused by its own wrongdoing. The agreement lasts three years and renews automatically for two-year periods unless notice of non-renewal is given, and it can also be terminated for uncured material breach. German law governs the agreement, disputes must be brought in Hamburg, and any product development work would be done under separate agreed statements of work.
